question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Although he is a calm person most of the time, he occasionally loses his _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **"temper"**. (खीज)
 
• **"Temper"** refers to a person's tendency to become angry or lose control of their emotions.
 
 
• **Example**: *Her temper flared when she discovered the broken toys.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, **temper** describes someone who is usually calm but can occasionally become angry.
 
• Hence, **"temper" **is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

**Complete Sentence**: "Although he is a calm person most of the time, he occasionally loses his **temper**__."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Anger" **is a strong feeling of displeasure or hostility aroused by injustice, or wrongdoing. (गुस्सा)
 
• **"Calm"** refers to a state of peacefulness, or absence of agitation. (शांत)
 
• **"Anxiety"** refers to a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something. (चिंता)
